title: Warmly Spiced Japanese Salmon Wrap
description: A malty and light pescatarian-friendly dish featuring shichimi-togarashi and miso-marinate, served in a pandan-leaf-wrap, perfect for a brunch mood
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a small bowl, mix together miso paste, shichimi-togarashi, and soy sauce to create the marinade.
Place the salmon fillets in a shallow dish and brush the marinade on both sides of the fish.
Let the salmon marinate for 10 minutes.
Wrap each salmon fillet in a pandan leaf, making sure to seal the edges.
Place the wrapped salmon on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the salmon for 12 minutes or until it reaches an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
While the salmon is cooking, prepare the sushi rice according to the package instructions.
Assemble the wrap by placing a piece of cooked salmon on a bed of sushi rice, topping with pickled ginger and cucumber slices.
